_about: #8399 follow-up to 2026-11-08-seam-markers-8399.json: arm A0 (production @4 with no previous-page English, PR #8410) and the seam pass as BUILT (scripts/lib/seam-pass.mjs, claude-translate.mjs --seam-pass=1), on #8407's 120 blocks / 69 books, agy gemini-3.8-flash-low. Same #7118 Opus seam judge, re-run blind over every arm in one session (judge-floor 235/236 agree, plants caught 227/230). S = broken joins at a block start per 100, T = inside a block, lane = 0.75 T + 0.25 S. Write-up: scripts/eval/experiments/2026-11-08-seam-pass-stage-8399.md; verdicts: scripts/eval/results/seam-pass-8399/report.json.

routes.A: production: per-call=4, page tags, previous-page English (run 1)
routes.A0+stage: A0 + the built seam pass, edits to the page before the block allowed (seam_pass 'edit-before')
routes.A0+stage-locked: A0 + the built seam pass, page before the block never edited (seam_pass true)
routes.C: #8407's eval copy of the seam pass, on Bb
routes.Bb+stage: the built seam pass on Bb (the like-for-like check against C)

decision: seam_pass 'edit-before' on latin-cli-agy4 and german-cli-agy4 (the built stage scores like C: lane 8.1 vs 9.7, S 16.9 vs 18.6). PR #8410 (no previous English) stays blocked: A0 S is 5.1 per 100 worse than mean(A, A2), three times the A-vs-A2 swing, and its term consistency is slightly worse on both measures; the seam pass recovers A0's block starts (17.8) but cannot touch term consistency.
